caseName: Dictograph Products Co. v. Sonotone Corp.
caseNameFull: Dictograph Products Co., Inc. v. Sonotone Corporation
attorneys: Louis P. Haffer for petitioner. John E. Fetzer was on the stipulation for Greibach, respondent. With him on a brief in opposition to the petition was Charles H. Tuttle for the Sonotone Corporation, respondent.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
